principle: Hot path for real-time connectivity; cold path for eventual convergence. Relays are disposable coordination, never trusted state.
hard_truth: Guaranteed real-time connection between arbitrary peers behind restrictive NAT/CGNAT is impossible without some reachable rendezvous/relay or an out-of-band carrier. v24 removes single-provider dependence by combining multiple hot-path relays with an asynchronous cold path.
